The scratches are being removed through fine polishing/sanding. The small abrasive particles in the liquid foundation makeup are acting like a polishing compound. The fine grit emery board may be helping too, but you could probably get away with a fine cloth just the same. This is how you polish metal. I don't know if the back of the phone is coated with anything such as an anodized tint or protective lacquer, but if it is, then this method will make the polished spot look different since it will remove the top surface of the metal. If you do this on brushed aluminum then it will become smooth and will definitely look different. jewelers rouge or rubbing compound do the same thing as the makeup but probably much better.
